thread:
alice: Heads-up — planning a controlled toggle for feature flag `multisvc-llm-route-v5` during tonight's 23:00 UTC change window. Need ops + oncall signoff.
sofia: ack, I'm oncall tonight. what's the ramp plan?
diego: if we can keep initial cohort small and pinned to warm instances that'd help. p95/err targets?
alice: plan: 0% -> 1% (5m soak) -> 5% (10m) -> 25% (20m) -> 100% (gradual). Rollout will be cohort-based by region: eu-west -> us-east -> ap-south. Pin to model v5.0.2 for the first 25%.
priya: +1. Also request: add a deploybot safeguard to auto-drain/unpin if p50 latency increases >30% or error rate >1.5x baseline in any cohort for 5m.
tom: product side will monitor quality regressions using the eval set; if semantic score drops >4 pts we abort. We'll post eval link in the thread when available. :mag:
deploy-bot: Scheduled toggle for `multisvc-llm-route-v5` at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Canary cohort: 1% eu-west. Safety controls: circuit-breaker + automatic rollback thresholds configured.
sofia: please include exact thresholds in the deploy notes so oncall doesn't have to parse configs mid-incident.
alice: pasted config below for quick reference:
```json
{
  "flag": "multisvc-llm-route-v5",
  "initial": "0",
  "ramp": [
    {"percent": 1, "duration_mins": 5, "region": "eu-west", "model_version": "v5.0.2"},
    {"percent": 5, "duration_mins": 10, "region": "eu-west,us-east"},
    {"percent": 25, "duration_mins": 20, "region": "all"},
    {"percent": 100, "duration_mins": 0, "region": "all"}
  ],
  "auto_rollback": {
    "error_rate_multiplier": 1.5,
    "latency_p50_pct_increase": 30,
    "duration_mins": 5
  },
  "pin_version": "v5.0.2"
}
```
diego: looks good. two ops notes: 1) ensure pinned machines have KV cache warmed; 2) don't co-locate canary with existing heavy batch jobs.
priya: I'll set the deploy-bot to mark the rollout paused at each gate for manual approval if any signal is close to threshold (within 10%).
alice: agreed — make gates manual at 5% and 25% so we can inspect trace samples and eval results. automated rollback remains enabled for hard breaches.
tom: eval link: https://internal-evals/redwood/multisvc-v5/compare — I'll drop a short dashboard summary at each gate.
sofia: oncall checklist: command to drain cohort quick revert: `curl -XPOST https://deploy.internal/api/flags/multisvc-llm-route-v5/revert -d '{"to":0}'` — we should pin that in runbook.
deploy-bot: Canary toggle executed: set to 1% in eu-west at 5987654400. Monitoring hooks registered.
diego: seeing healthy KV hit rates on the canary warm pool. latency stable so far.
alice: keep eyes on error traces for unknown model mismatches — last time we had a subtle tokenization fallback.
priya: noted. adding a quick log filter and alert for `tokenize_error` and `cache_miss_spike`.
tom: product eval > no meaningful regressions at 1% after 10m. proceeding to 5% in 10m unless objection. :thumbsup:
sofia: no objections. I'll be watching. set me a 10m reminder before the 5% gate.
alice: reminder set. deploy-bot will pause for manual approval at 5% and 25% as requested. thanks all.
